# Summary & Financial Case Study {#sec-summary}

This chapter illustrates loading external CSV datasets and formatting publication-ready accounting tables.

## Quarterly Performance Analysis

We load company financials from an external CSV file stored in the project data directory.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-financials
#| tbl-cap: "Quarterly Revenue vs Expenses (USD)"
#| echo: true

# Read the external CSV file
fin_data <- read.csv("data/financials.csv")

# Compute Net Profit dynamically
fin_data$Net_Profit <- fin_data$Revenue - 
  fin_data$Expenses

# Display with knitr::kable
knitr::kable(fin_data)
```

As highlighted in @tbl-financials, profitability expanded across all four operating quarters.
